title: Everyday Phrases — A Camping Trip
scene_zh: 露營之旅 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】⛺ 實用露營之旅必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Camping Trip
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用露營之旅情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從抵達營地報到選營位，到搭帳篷、打地釘、鋪防潮墊與睡袋，再到生篝火、烤肉、盪吊床、看星空，最後清晨收帳篷、清理營位、退房並約定下次再見，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Camping Trip phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering check-in and picking a campsite, pitching the tent with stakes and sleeping bags, campfire cooking, hammocks and starry skies, then packing up a dewy tent, cleaning the site, checking out, and planning the next trip. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We finally found the campground!
dialogue.zh: 我們終於找到露營地了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's check in at the office.
dialogue.zh: 我們先去管理處報到吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do campers need a reservation?
dialogue.zh: 來露營需要事先預訂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I booked our site online.
dialogue.zh: 需要，我在網路上訂好營位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me the booking?
dialogue.zh: 能給我看一下預訂紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is under my name.
dialogue.zh: 就在這兒，是用我的名字訂的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two nights in site number twelve.
dialogue.zh: 十二號營位，住兩個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the spot near the small lake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə spɑt nɪr ðə smɔl leɪk/
dialogue.zh: 就是小湖旁邊那個營位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put this sticker on your car.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz pʊt ðɪs ˈstɪkər ɑn ʊr kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 請把這張貼紙貼在你們車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where should I place it?
dialogue.zh: 要貼在哪個位置呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the corner of the back window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ˈkɔrnər ʌv ðə bæk ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 後車窗的角落就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, done in one second.
dialogue.zh: 收到，一秒貼好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do quiet hours start?
dialogue.zh: 安寧時段幾點開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They begin at ten o'clock, sharp.
dialogue.zh: 晚上十點整準時開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we play music before then?
dialogue.zh: 那之前可以播放音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just keep the volume low.
dialogue.zh: 可以，音量保持小聲就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are campfires allowed at this site?
dialogue.zh: 這個營位允許生篝火嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only inside the metal fire ring.
dialogue.zh: 只能在金屬火圈裡面生火。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the clean restrooms?
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的洗手間在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk past the big oak tree.
dialogue.zh: 走過那棵大橡樹就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do showers cost extra money?
dialogue.zh: 淋浴要另外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, coins work in the machines.
dialogue.zh: 要錢，淋浴機台是投幣式的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tap water safe to drink?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tæp ˈwɔtər seɪf tu drɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 自來水可以直接喝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the main faucet is nearby.
dialogue.zh: 可以，共用水龍頭就在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should grab some water first.
dialogue.zh: 我們先去打一些水吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the big blue jug along.
dialogue.zh: 把那個藍色大水壺帶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do campers throw trash?
dialogue.zh: 露營客把垃圾丟在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bear-proof bins by the entrance.
dialogue.zh: 入口處的防熊垃圾桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we brought trash bags too.
dialogue.zh: 好在我們也自帶了垃圾袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always pack out your own waste.
dialogue.zh: 自己的垃圾一定要自己帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's drive to our site now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在開車去營位吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the brown numbered signs.
dialogue.zh: 跟著棕色編號指標走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Site twelve, is this the turn?
dialogue.zh: 十二號營位，是這個轉彎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take the road on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs teɪk ðə roʊd ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 對，走左邊那條路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see the number on a post.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑn ə poʊst/
dialogue.zh: 我看到柱子上的編號了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's ours, pull in slowly.
dialogue.zh: 就是我們的營位，慢慢開進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, this site looks nice and flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðɪs saɪt lʊks naɪs ænd flæt/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這營位又平又開闊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for pitching our tent.
dialogue.zh: 最適合搭我們的帳篷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those roots a problem?
dialogue.zh: 那些樹根會有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can move around them easily.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以輕鬆避開它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at all these pinecones.
dialogue.zh: 看這滿地的松果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's clear them off the ground.
dialogue.zh: 我們把地面清理乾淨吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shade feels so good.
dialogue.zh: 這片樹蔭真涼快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big trees keep the site cool.
dialogue.zh: 大樹讓營地特別涼快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lake close from here?
dialogue.zh: 從這裡離湖邊近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a five minute walk away.
dialogue.zh: 走路五分鐘就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there snakes in this area?
dialogue.zh: 這一帶有蛇嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch your step on rocky trails.
dialogue.zh: 岩石小徑上走路要小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are bears really around here?
dialogue.zh: 這附近真的有熊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Store food in the metal box.
dialogue.zh: 食物要收進鐵製防熊箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we leave the car?
dialogue.zh: 我們要把車留在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here in the gravel spot.
dialogue.zh: 就在這片碎石停車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to unload all our gear.
dialogue.zh: 該把所有裝備卸下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the tent and poles.
dialogue.zh: 先拿帳篷和營柱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This backpack is heavier than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈbækˌpæk ɪz ˈhɛviər ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 這背包比我想像中重多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I'll carry the green one.
dialogue.zh: 來，我幫你提綠色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we bring enough chairs?
dialogue.zh: 我們帶的椅子夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four folding ones in the trunk.
dialogue.zh: 後車廂裡有四張摺疊椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the cooler in the shade.
dialogue.zh: 保冷箱要放在陰涼處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add ice right away.
dialogue.zh: 我馬上把冰塊加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our tent really this big?
dialogue.zh: 我們的帳篷真的這麼大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sleeps four, plenty of room.
dialogue.zh: 能睡四個人，空間很夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's say hi to our neighbors.
dialogue.zh: 跟隔壁營位的鄰居打個招呼吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They waved at us already.
dialogue.zh: 他們已經朝我們揮手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice day for camping, right?
dialogue.zh: 今天真適合露營，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunny now, clouds coming later.
dialogue.zh: 現在晴朗，待會兒會起雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we expect rain tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚可能會下雨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app says maybe after midnight.
dialogue.zh: 天氣預報說午夜後可能下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we need the rainfly ready.
dialogue.zh: 那就要把防雨罩備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in the orange stuff bag.
dialogue.zh: 它在那個橘色收納袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can the kids run around?
dialogue.zh: 孩子們可以在哪裡跑跳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's an open field downhill.
dialogue.zh: 坡下有一片開闊的草地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a playground nearby?
dialogue.zh: 附近有遊樂場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten minutes by car.
dialogue.zh: 有，開車過去十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No cell signal out here?
dialogue.zh: 這邊沒有手機訊號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bar near the big hill.
dialogue.zh: 那座高坡附近會有一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, that's fine with me.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我倒覺得無所謂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, let's truly disconnect today.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，今天就徹底放下手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's our plan for tonight?
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚有什麼安排？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set up, cook, then watch the stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ʌp kʊk ðɛn wɑtʃ ðə stɑrz/
dialogue.zh: 先搭營，再做飯，然後看星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's mark our spot with chairs.
dialogue.zh: 先把椅子擺好圈出地盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the sun moves fast here.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這邊太陽移動得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we pack a hammer?
dialogue.zh: 我們帶鎚子了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's buried in the tool bag.
dialogue.zh: 在工具袋的最底層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Over here, the ground feels really hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊvər hɪr ðə ɡraʊnd filz ˈrɪli hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 這邊的土硬得像石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the softer dirt near trees.
dialogue.zh: 試試樹邊比較軟的泥土。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any level place for the hammock?
dialogue.zh: 有哪塊平地適合架吊床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pines by the path work well.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu paɪnz baɪ ðə pæθ wɜrk wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 小路邊那兩棵松樹很合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunset is around eight fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 日落大約在八點十五分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So daytime still lasts a while.
dialogue.zh: 那白天還有一段時間呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's hurry before the light fades.
dialogue.zh: 趁天沒黑抓緊幹吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, headlamp in my pocket.
dialogue.zh: 同意，頭燈就在我口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Camping makes me so excited.
dialogue.zh: 一想到要露營我就好興奮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I've waited all month for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪv ˈweɪtəd ɔl mʌnθ fər ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我整個月都在期待這一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our kids can't stop smiling.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們笑得停不下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This was the best idea ever.
dialogue.zh: 這主意真是史上最棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Welcome to our home for two nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm tu ˈaʊər hoʊm fər tu naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來到我們這兩晚的家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Home sweet outdoor home.
dialogue.zh: 戶外的小窩，甜蜜的家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's build our little camp.
dialogue.zh: 現在來搭建我們的小營地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll hold the bags, you start.
dialogue.zh: 我提著袋子，你先動手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unroll the tent on flat ground.
dialogue.zh: 把帳篷在平地上攤開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth out every wrinkle first.
dialogue.zh: 先把每一個皺褶抹平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget the footprint underneath.
dialogue.zh: 別忘了底層要鋪防水地布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps ground moisture off the tent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips ɡraʊnd ˈmɔɪstʃər ɔf ðə tɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 它能隔開地面滲上來的濕氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now assemble the long poles.
dialogue.zh: 現在把長營柱接起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide the sections end to end.
dialogue.zh: 把每段一端接一端滑好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pole section seems bent.
dialogue.zh: 這段營柱好像是彎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's spring steel, it straightens fine.
dialogue.zh: 是彈簧鋼的，會自己變直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the pole tip in the hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə poʊl tɪp ɪn ðə hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 把營柱頭插進孔洞裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which corner should we do next?
dialogue.zh: 我們下一個弄哪個角？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start front left, then clip the rings.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt frʌnt lɛft ðɛn klɪp ðə rɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 先弄左前角，再扣掛環。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm clipping them one by one.
dialogue.zh: 我一個一個扣上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the middle now, gently.
dialogue.zh: 現在輕輕把中間撐起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the tent stands up!
dialogue.zh: 看，帳篷站起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not so fast, one pole slipped out.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt soʊ fæst wʌn poʊl slɪpt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 別急，有一根柱子滑出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it back until it clicks.
dialogue.zh: 推回去，聽到喀噠一聲就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, stake down the four corners.
dialogue.zh: 好，先給四個角打地釘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Angle the stake away from the tent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæŋɡəl ðə steɪk əˈweɪ frʌm ðə tɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 地釘要朝帳篷外側傾斜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do stakes go in slanted?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼地釘要斜著打？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hold much stronger that way.
dialogue.zh: 那樣抓地力會更強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This soil is full of stones.
dialogue.zh: 這片土裡全是碎石。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the stake a few inches.
dialogue.zh: 把釘位挪開幾吋就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, guy lines look a bit loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ɡaɪ laɪnz lʊk ə bɪt lus/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，固定繩看起來有點鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tighten them to fight the wind.
dialogue.zh: 把繩拉緊才抗得住風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the door facing the right way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə dɔr ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə raɪt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 門的朝向正確嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Face it away from the wind.
dialogue.zh: 門要背著風開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the rainfly over the top.
dialogue.zh: 現在把防雨罩蓋上帳頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clip its buckles at each base.
dialogue.zh: 在每個底角扣好釦環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the mesh windows closed?
dialogue.zh: 所有紗窗都關好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, no gaps left open.
dialogue.zh: 都閉好了，沒留縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that keeps bugs outside.
dialogue.zh: 很好，蟲子就進不來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the zipper on the door.
dialogue.zh: 檢查門口那條拉鏈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sticks a little halfway.
dialogue.zh: 拉到一半會有點卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear the fabric from the teeth.
dialogue.zh: 把夾住的布從鏈齒撥開就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it glides perfectly smooth.
dialogue.zh: 現在拉起來絲滑順暢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice fix, you're a pro now.
dialogue.zh: 修得漂亮，你變專家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, we blow up the sleeping pads.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wi bloʊ ʌp ðə ˈslipɪŋ pædz/
dialogue.zh: 接下來給防潮墊打氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small hand pump is here.
dialogue.zh: 小手動泵就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pumps does one pad need?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni pʌmps duz wʌn pæd nid/
dialogue.zh: 一個墊子要打個幾下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty quick strokes should do it.
dialogue.zh: 快速打二十下就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine feels too soft already.
dialogue.zh: 我這個摸起來軟趴趴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add air and close the valve.
dialogue.zh: 補點氣，再把閥門關緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No leaking now, it holds well.
dialogue.zh: 現在不漏氣了，撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, no more rocks under us.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，再也不會躺硬地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, it's like a real bed.
dialogue.zh: 好耶，像真正的床一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one zips onto that one.
dialogue.zh: 這個可以和那個拼接起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we join two bags together?
dialogue.zh: 兩個睡袋可以接成一張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, their zippers connect easily.
dialogue.zh: 可以，拉鏈很容易就能接起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the kids' spare sleeping pad?
dialogue.zh: 孩子們那張備用睡墊在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, let's pump it up.
dialogue.zh: 就在這兒，我們把它打飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It bounced right back when I pressed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt baʊnst raɪt bæk wɛn aɪ prɛst/
dialogue.zh: 我一按下去它立刻彈回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect firmness, leave it there.
dialogue.zh: 軟硬適中，就放那兒別動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should pillows go inside the tent?
dialogue.zh: 枕頭要帶進帳篷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soft bedding means better sleep.
dialogue.zh: 對，寢具軟一點，睡得更香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag won't close at all.
dialogue.zh: 我的收納袋怎麼也合不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sitting on it usually works.
dialogue.zh: 坐上去壓著收，通常有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It popped the zipper open again.
dialogue.zh: 結果拉鏈又崩開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try rolling it tighter instead.
dialogue.zh: 試著把它捲得更緊再收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, it finally fits.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，終於塞進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Packing is a real skill.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，收納還真是門技術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the lantern on the table.
dialogue.zh: 把營燈放到折桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang another one inside the tent.
dialogue.zh: 帳篷裡面再掛一盞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do batteries last all night?
dialogue.zh: 電池撐得過一整夜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These LED ones last for days.
dialogue.zh: 這種省電燈能用好幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes come off before entering.
dialogue.zh: 進帳篷之前要脫鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll line them neatly by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl laɪn ðɛm ˈnitli baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我會把它們整整齊齊排在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sand inside ruins everything.
dialogue.zh: 沙子帶進帳篷，睡覺就毀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mat at the entrance helps.
dialogue.zh: 門口鋪的那塊小墊子有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No snacks inside the tent.
dialogue.zh: 零食絕對不能帶進帳篷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smells invite mice and curious bugs.
dialogue.zh: 食物的香味會招來老鼠和蟲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you check the seams?
dialogue.zh: 帳篷接縫你有檢查過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All dry, no holes anywhere.
dialogue.zh: 都是乾的，沒發現破洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pole clip keeps popping off.
dialogue.zh: 有個掛扣一直自己崩開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push down hard until it locks.
dialogue.zh: 往下用力按到卡住為止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That did the trick, thanks!
dialogue.zh: 這樣真的好了，謝謝！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teamwork makes setup feel easy.
dialogue.zh: 兩人搭配幹活就不覺得難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our whole tent looks so steady.
dialogue.zh: 整座帳篷看起來穩當極了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a little shake test.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕搖一下，測試穩不穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Solid, nothing moved at all.
dialogue.zh: 結實得很，紋絲不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we're ready for wind now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在颳風也不怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the door net zipped tight?
dialogue.zh: 紗門拉鏈拉得嚴實嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mosquitoes stay outside tonight.
dialogue.zh: 嚴實著呢，蚊子進不來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to arrange the sleeping area.
dialogue.zh: 該來佈置睡覺的那一區了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pads down, bags on top, done.
dialogue.zh: 墊子鋪平、睡袋放上面，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chargers inside from the car?
dialogue.zh: 車上的充電器要拿進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep the phone within reach.
dialogue.zh: 要，手機得放在伸手可及的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A jacket by the door too.
dialogue.zh: 門口再隨手放一件外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nights get cold out here.
dialogue.zh: 這兒夜裡溫度降得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we done with setup?
dialogue.zh: 我們這邊搭完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly, just fold the empty bags.
dialogue.zh: 快了，把空袋子摺好收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tarp can hold wet shoes.
dialogue.zh: 這塊防水布可以用來擱濕鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan for tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 明早出門正好用得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit down, our camp looks great.
dialogue.zh: 坐會兒吧，咱們的營地搭得超棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only forty minutes, not bad!
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘就搭完，真不賴！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm thirsty after all that work.
dialogue.zh: 忙完這一陣，口好渴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold juice waits in the cooler.
dialogue.zh: 冰果汁正在保冷箱裡等著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheers to our new camp!
dialogue.zh: 為我們的新營地乾杯！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And to our steady little tent.
dialogue.zh: 也為這頂結實的小帳篷乾杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now what's next on the list?
dialogue.zh: 清單上的下一步要幹嘛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fire first, then cook dinner outside.
dialogue.zh: 先生篝火，再到外頭做晚飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should gather some dry firewood.
dialogue.zh: 我們去撿一些乾柴吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only fallen branches, never live trees.
dialogue.zh: 只撿掉下來的枯枝，不砍活樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These thin sticks burn very fast.
dialogue.zh: 這些細柴火燒得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for starting the fire.
dialogue.zh: 正好拿來當引火的底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fire ring clean?
dialogue.zh: 火圈裡面乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll sweep out the old ash.
dialogue.zh: 我把上家留的灰燼掃乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I build the wood pile?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ bɪld ðə wʊd paɪl/
dialogue.zh: 柴堆要怎麼架起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack logs like a tiny cabin.
dialogue.zh: 像蓋小木屋那樣交叉疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One match and it catches.
dialogue.zh: 一根火柴就把火點著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow gently to feed the flame.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕吹，讓火苗更旺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the flames are dancing already.
dialogue.zh: 看，火苗已經跳起舞來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep everything back from the tent.
dialogue.zh: 所有東西都要離帳篷遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're safe inside this metal ring.
dialogue.zh: 有金屬圈圍著，我們很安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never leave the fire burning alone.
dialogue.zh: 絕對別讓火堆獨自燒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner time, who is the chef?
dialogue.zh: 開飯時間，誰來當大廚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight I grill the sausages.
dialogue.zh: 今晚由我來烤香腸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the charcoal needs ten more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ðə ˈtʃɑrˌkoʊl nidz tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 木炭還得再燒十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait till it turns gray and hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt tɪl ɪt tɜrnz ɡreɪ ænd hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 等炭變灰、發燙了再烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the meat on the grill.
dialogue.zh: 把肉排放上烤架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flip it once, don't poke it.
dialogue.zh: 只翻一次面，別亂戳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It smells amazing already.
dialogue.zh: 這才多久，已經香死人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Corn goes on the side too.
dialogue.zh: 邊上再烤幾根玉米。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Burgers or hot dogs first?
dialogue.zh: 先烤漢堡還是熱狗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dogs first, kids always pick dogs.
dialogue.zh: 先熱狗，小孩永遠選熱狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buns are in the paper bag.
dialogue.zh: 麵包夾在紙袋裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ketchup and mustard live in the cooler.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛtʃəp ænd ˈmʌstərd lɪv ɪn ðə ˈkulər/
dialogue.zh: 番茄醬和芥末醬都在保冷箱裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the grill is very hot.
dialogue.zh: 小心，烤架燙得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll use these long oven mitts.
dialogue.zh: 我會用這副長隔熱手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the folding table closer.
dialogue.zh: 把折疊桌往火邊挪近點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plates and cups are set already.
dialogue.zh: 碗盤杯子都已經擺好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper plates make cleanup easy.
dialogue.zh: 用紙盤子收拾起來輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We still need one washtub.
dialogue.zh: 不過還是要備一個洗碗盆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm water melts the grease.
dialogue.zh: 溫水能把油垢化掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrape the plates, then rinse them.
dialogue.zh: 盤子刮乾淨再用水沖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner's served, come sit down.
dialogue.zh: 開飯啦，快過來坐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This beats takeout any day.
dialogue.zh: 這比點外送好吃一百倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pass me the salt, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把鹽罐遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, and try these chips too.
dialogue.zh: 來，也試試這些脆片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marshmallows after dinner, right?
dialogue.zh: 飯後的甜點是烤棉花糖吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, we'll roast them now.
dialogue.zh: 那當然，這就開烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stick the marshmallow on the fork.
dialogue.zh: 把棉花糖插到長叉上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it near the flames, not in.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt nɪr ðə fleɪmz nɑt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 湊近火苗就好，別插進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine turned golden and soft.
dialogue.zh: 我那顆烤得金黃綿軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sandwich it between two crackers.
dialogue.zh: 夾進兩片蘇打餅乾中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chocolate goes on the bottom.
dialogue.zh: 巧克力片墊在最底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This gooey s'more tastes perfect.
dialogue.zh: 這黏口的夾心甜進心裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't burn yours like last time.
dialogue.zh: 別像上次烤成一團黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patience, I'm going slowly now.
dialogue.zh: 要有耐心，我現在慢得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fire gives a cozy crackle.
dialogue.zh: 柴火劈啪作響，好療癒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I could listen to it all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʊd ˈlɪsən tu ɪt ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我能坐著聽上一整晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's move to the hammock now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在挪去吊床那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test it before sitting fully.
dialogue.zh: 整個坐下去前先拉拉看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It holds me with room left.
dialogue.zh: 它撐得住我還有富餘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save some space for me too.
dialogue.zh: 也給我留一點位置嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sky is turning orange now.
dialogue.zh: 天空正被染成橘紅色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No screen can beat these colors.
dialogue.zh: 任何螢幕都比不過這片晚霞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the first star appeared.
dialogue.zh: 看，第一顆星星出現了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon the whole sky will sparkle.
dialogue.zh: 一會兒整片夜空都會閃爍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are no streetlights here.
dialogue.zh: 這邊連盞路燈都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why the stars shine brighter.
dialogue.zh: 所以星星才顯得格外亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you find the Big Dipper?
dialogue.zh: 你找得到北斗七星嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right above those tall pines.
dialogue.zh: 就在那些高松樹的正上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shooting star, make a wish!
dialogue.zh: 有流星，快許個心願！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wished to camp here again.
dialogue.zh: 我許的願是下次再來露營。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point the flashlight at the trees.
dialogue.zh: 手電筒往那排樹照一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see two round eyes up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si tu raʊnd aɪz ʌp ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我看到樹上有兩隻圓圓的眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Owls bring good luck, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我聽說貓頭鷹會帶來好運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, it hooted two more times.
dialogue.zh: 你聽，牠又叫了兩聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's that sound in the dark?
dialogue.zh: 黑漆漆的那是什麼聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably just a little raccoon.
dialogue.zh: 大概就是只小浣熊在找吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it touch our food box?
dialogue.zh: 牠有沒有碰到我們的食物箱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lid stays locked, don't worry.
dialogue.zh: 蓋子鎖得好好的，放心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mosquitoes love this evening air.
dialogue.zh: 蚊子最愛傍晚的空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spray repellent on your arms.
dialogue.zh: 手臂上記得噴驅蚊液。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got one bite already.
dialogue.zh: 我已經被叮了一個包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub cream on, it stops itching.
dialogue.zh: 抹點藥膏就不會癢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Firewood is low again.
dialogue.zh: 柴火又快燒見底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saved a bundle by the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ə ˈbʌndl baɪ ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 桌子邊我特意留了一捆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toss two logs in the middle.
dialogue.zh: 往火堆中間丟兩根木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, the fire jumps right back up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ðə ˈfaɪər dʒʌmps raɪt bæk ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 瞧，火舌立刻就竄高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stars are coming out one by one.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrz ɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ aʊt wʌn baɪ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 星星一顆一顆跑出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the moon joined the party.
dialogue.zh: 月亮也趕來湊熱鬧了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sky looks painted tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今夜的天空像畫上去的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No city glow ruins it here.
dialogue.zh: 沒有城市燈光打擾這片夜景。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stay up longer?
dialogue.zh: 我們能再多熬一會兒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, then beds, deal?
dialogue.zh: 一小時，然後就寢，成交？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hammock swings in the breeze.
dialogue.zh: 吊床隨著微風輕輕搖擺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rocks me like a baby.
dialogue.zh: 像搖籃一樣，舒服極了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold my legs, I'm sliding!
dialogue.zh: 抓住我的腿，我要滑下去啦！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've got you, lie back flat.
dialogue.zh: 拉住你了，往後躺平就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's getting chilly out here.
dialogue.zh: 坐在外頭越來越涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sip this cocoa while it's hot.
dialogue.zh: 趁熱把這杯可可喝了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's put the fire out safely.
dialogue.zh: 我們安全地把火熄掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water first, then stir the ash.
dialogue.zh: 先潑水，再攪開灰燼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ash cold enough now?
dialogue.zh: 灰燼現在夠涼了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not quite, one more splash of water.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt kwaɪt wʌn mɔr splæʃ ʌv ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 還沒全涼，再潑一瓢水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything's dark, the fire is done.
dialogue.zh: 一片漆黑，火堆收工了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time to crawl into our bags.
dialogue.zh: 是時候鑽進睡袋裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last peek at the stars.
dialogue.zh: 睡覺前再最後看一眼星空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight, watch them through the net.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，隔著紗頂慢慢看吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, sleepy camper.
dialogue.zh: 早安啊，愛睡的露營鬼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best sleep in years, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，這是我幾年來睡得最香的一晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the cold wake you up?
dialogue.zh: 半夜有被冷醒過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, but my bag kept me warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns bət maɪ bæɡ kɛpt mi wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 醒了一次，不過睡袋把我暖回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the birds are starting their concert.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ðə bɜrdz ɑr ˈstɑrtɪŋ ðɛr ˈkɑnˌsɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 你聽，鳥兒開始開演唱會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than any alarm clock.
dialogue.zh: 比任何鬧鐘都好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tent is wet inside.
dialogue.zh: 我的帳篷裡面溼溼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the sleeping pads stayed dry.
dialogue.zh: 不過防潮墊一點都沒潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun will fix that fast.
dialogue.zh: 太陽出來，一會兒就乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky us, sunshine came early.
dialogue.zh: 我們真幸運，太陽一早就出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's air the tent out.
dialogue.zh: 我們把帳篷開開風吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open both doors and the top.
dialogue.zh: 前後門和頂窗全部敞開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee first, chores later.
dialogue.zh: 先喝咖啡，雜事待會兒再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll boil water on the stove.
dialogue.zh: 我用爐子燒一壺水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Instant coffee still tastes rich.
dialogue.zh: 即溶咖啡喝起來依然濃郁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outside, everything tastes better.
dialogue.zh: 在戶外，什麼東西都變好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shh, the kids are still asleep.
dialogue.zh: 噓，孩子們還睡得正沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whisper, and pack quietly.
dialogue.zh: 小聲點，我們輕輕地收東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breakfast: eggs or pancakes?
dialogue.zh: 早餐要吃雞蛋還是煎鬆餅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pancakes, the kids will wake up!
dialogue.zh: 鬆餅！小孩們會立刻跳起來！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These eggs crack so easily.
dialogue.zh: 這些雞蛋也太容易裂開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crack them on the pan edge.
dialogue.zh: 在鍋邊上敲蛋就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pan is ready, light the burner.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ pæn ɪz ˈrɛdi laɪt ðə ˈbɜrnər/
dialogue.zh: 平底鍋備好了，點爐頭吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gas connects with a simple twist.
dialogue.zh: 氣閥輕輕一轉就接通了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the little blue flame.
dialogue.zh: 看，那朵藍色的小火苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect heat for slow pancakes.
dialogue.zh: 煎鬆餅就要這種溫柔小火。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dew covers every chair leg.
dialogue.zh: 每張椅腳都沾滿了露水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them before we stack.
dialogue.zh: 疊收之前先把它們擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My jacket got damp overnight.
dialogue.zh: 我外套擱在外面一晚上，受潮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it in the sun a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt ɪn ðə sʌn ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先掛在太陽底下曬一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These tent poles come apart easily.
dialogue.zh: 這些營柱很容易就能拆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe each section before storing.
dialogue.zh: 每段擦乾淨了再收袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the stakes straight, not sideways.
dialogue.zh: 地釘要垂直拔出，別硬掰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twisting helps them slide right out.
dialogue.zh: 邊轉邊拉，一下就拔出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One guy line is tangled.
dialogue.zh: 有條固定繩打結纏住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loosen the knots one loop at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlusən ðə nɑts wʌn luːp æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 一圈一圈把繩結鬆開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This fabric dried faster than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈfæbrɪk draɪd ˈfæstər ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 這篷布乾得比我想像中快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we can fold it now.
dialogue.zh: 正好，現在能摺疊收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brush the dirt off the floor.
dialogue.zh: 把帳篷裡的泥沙掃出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small broom works wonders.
dialogue.zh: 小掃把一出手就有奇效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did my other sock go?
dialogue.zh: 我另一隻襪子跑哪兒去了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It slept under the pillow.
dialogue.zh: 原來躲在枕頭底下睡了一晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Melted ice filled the cooler.
dialogue.zh: 融化的冰水積滿了保冷箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tip it out and wipe it dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪp ɪt aʊt ænd waɪp ɪt draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 傾出來擦到全乾就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the raccoon return last night?
dialogue.zh: 昨晚那只浣熊又來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the food box held.
dialogue.zh: 來了，不過食物箱守住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our trash bag looks full.
dialogue.zh: 垃圾袋已經裝得滿滿的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carry it to the big bins.
dialogue.zh: 拎去倒進大垃圾桶吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave nothing but footprints here.
dialogue.zh: 除了腳印，什麼都彆留下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love that camping rule.
dialogue.zh: 我很喜歡這條露營守則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We used almost all firewood.
dialogue.zh: 咱們把柴火用得差不多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few sticks left, give them away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fju stɪks lɛft ɡɪv ðɛm əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 剩幾根，留給下一家吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See how clean the fire pit is.
dialogue.phonetic: /siː haʊ klin ðə ˈfaɪər pɪt ɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你看，火坑多乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next campers will thank us.
dialogue.zh: 下一組露營客會感謝我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do the chairs fold this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ðə tʃɛrz foʊld ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 摺疊椅這次要怎麼收？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the center, then snap it flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈsɛntər ðɛn snæp ɪt flæt/
dialogue.zh: 按住中間，喀嚓壓平就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything fits the trunk, somehow.
dialogue.zh: 真神奇，全部塞進後車廂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tent bag lies flat on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɛnt bæɡ laɪz flæt ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 帳篷袋平平壓在最上層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check under the picnic table.
dialogue.zh: 野餐桌底下來看一眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found two spoons and one napkin.
dialogue.zh: 撿到兩支湯匙一張紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any food left in the tent?
dialogue.zh: 帳篷裡還有沒帶走的食物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I checked the pockets twice.
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，口袋我都搜兩遍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready for the last checkout step.
dialogue.zh: 準備好做退房的最後一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Return the parking pass, then go.
dialogue.zh: 歸還停車證，然後就能走啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! The clerk took our pass.
dialogue.zh: 搞定！管理處人員收走停車證了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two fun nights end too fast.
dialogue.zh: 兩個開心的夜晚結束得太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were the restrooms clean today?
dialogue.zh: 今天洗手間還乾淨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone mopped it this morning.
dialogue.zh: 有人清晨剛拖過地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Car's packed, keys in hand.
dialogue.zh: 車裝好了，鑰匙也到手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more group photo first.
dialogue.zh: 先來一張大合照再出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say goodbye to the lake.
dialogue.zh: 跟小湖說一聲再見吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And to our friendly neighbors.
dialogue.zh: 也跟我們友善的鄰居道別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The site looks empty now.
dialogue.zh: 營位一下子空蕩蕩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty, but full of memories.
dialogue.zh: 空了，卻裝滿了回憶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drive home feels shorter.
dialogue.zh: 回家的車程感覺特別短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I miss it already, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我已經開始想念了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's book another campground soon.
dialogue.zh: 抓緊時間再訂一個露營地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same app, new lake this time?
dialogue.zh: 還用同一個軟體，這次換個湖？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any site with a fire ring.
dialogue.zh: 要附火圈的那種營位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm already planning our next trip.
dialogue.zh: 我已經在盤算下次旅行了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring better snacks next time.
dialogue.zh: 下次我一定帶更好吃的零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And more batteries, we ran out.
dialogue.zh: 電池也要多備，這次用光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe next time we try fishing.
dialogue.zh: 下次咱們試試看釣魚怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll lend you my old rod.
dialogue.zh: 我那支舊釣竿可以借你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we forget anything, really?
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我們落下什麼東西了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only our footprints, exactly as planned.
dialogue.zh: 只留下腳印，跟說好的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Camping is hard work but worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæmpɪŋ ɪz hɑrd wɜrk bət wɜrθ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 露營雖累，可真的太值了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next weekend, count me in again.
dialogue.zh: 下個週末，算我一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids fell asleep in the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz fɛl əˈslip ɪn ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 孩子們一上車就睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dreaming of marshmallows and stars.
dialogue.zh: 夢裡八成是棉花糖和星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We smell like smoke and pine.
dialogue.zh: 我們渾身都是篝火和松針的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shower tonight, camp again soon.
dialogue.zh: 今晚好好洗澡，過幾天再露營。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll print the best photos tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我要把最棒的幾張洗出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them on the fridge door.
dialogue.zh: 貼在冰箱門上慢慢欣賞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Share the album with the neighbors.
dialogue.zh: 把相簿分享給隔壁鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They promised a lake trip next.
dialogue.zh: 他們說下次一起去湖邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next trip, we bring the bike rack.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst trɪp wi brɪŋ ðə baɪk ræk/
dialogue.zh: 下次出門把腳踏車架也帶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we ride and camp both days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi raɪd ænd kæmp boʊθ deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這樣兩天既能騎車又能露營。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good camp, good people, good rest.
dialogue.zh: 好營地，好朋友，睡個好覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until the next tent, goodbye.
dialogue.zh: 等下次帳篷撐起，再見啦。
